name: VBAP
description: Vector Base Amplitude Panning (sc3-plugins). Multichannel panner for arbitrary 2D or 3D loudspeaker arrays. Pans a mono source to numChans speakers using the VBAP algorithm by Ville Pulkki — selects the active speaker pair (2D) or triplet (3D) and computes amplitude gains so the perceived source comes from the requested direction. The bufnum input must reference a buffer prepared by VBAPSpeakerArray (loadToBuffer/sendToBuffer) describing the array geometry. Spread (0–100) widens the source from a point to a wider region by activating more speakers.

inputs.name: numChans
inputs.description: Number of output channels (must match the speaker count in the geometry buffer)

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the speaker geometry data produced by VBAPSpeakerArray.loadToBuffer/sendToBuffer

inputs.name: azimuth
inputs.description: Azimuth angle in degrees, -180 to 180 (0 = front, 90 = left, -90 = right)

inputs.name: elevation
inputs.description: Elevation angle in degrees, -90 to 90 (only meaningful for 3D arrays). Default 0 = horizontal plane

inputs.name: spread
inputs.description: Source spread, 0 to 100. 0 = point source, 100 = signal radiates from all speakers equally

name: CircleRamp
description: Phasor designed for circular panning (sc3-plugins). Lag-style smoother that wraps around a circular range — useful for smoothly ramping an azimuth value past the -180/180 boundary without sweeping the long way around. Picks the shortest direction between the current and target value within [circmin, circmax].

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Target value to ramp towards (typically an azimuth in degrees)

inputs.name: circmin
inputs.description: Minimum of the circular range (default -180 for azimuth in degrees)

inputs.name: circmax
inputs.description: Maximum of the circular range (default 180 for azimuth in degrees)

name: VBAPSpeakerArray
description: Builder for a VBAP loudspeaker geometry buffer (sc3-plugins). Computes the speaker pairs (2D) or triplets (3D) and the inverse matrices used by the VBAP UGen, then loads the result into a buffer. Pass the resulting buffer's bufnum to VBAP.

inputs.name: .dim(n)
inputs.description: Dimensionality of the speaker array, 2 or 3.

inputs.name: .speakers(directions)
inputs.description: Speaker directions. For dim=2 pass an array of azimuth angles in degrees; for dim=3 pass an array of [azimuth, elevation] pairs.

inputs.name: .add_speaker(speaker)
inputs.description: Append a single VBAPSpeaker entry to the array.

inputs.name: .load_to_buffer()
inputs.description: Compute the geometry data and load it into a buffer; returns the buffer.

name: VBAPSpeaker
description: Single speaker definition for a VBAPSpeakerArray (sc3-plugins). Describes one loudspeaker by its azimuth (in degrees from the front) and optional elevation (in degrees above the horizontal plane).
